Write code that extracts blocks, lines, tables, or layout elements from a document using a concrete provider.

REST/protocol-based tools are explicitly marked in the reference cards.

Option 1 — Mindee:
  Service: Mindee Document OCR
  SDK: mindee
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: parse, enqueue_and_parse
  Setup hints: MINDEE_API_KEY
  Official docs: https://developers.mindee.com/docs/python-sdk

Option 2 — Amazon Textract:
  Service: Amazon Textract
  SDK: boto3
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: detect_document_text, analyze_document
  Setup hints: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
  Official docs: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/textract/latest/dg/what-is.html

Option 3 — Alibaba Cloud OCR:
  Service: Alibaba Cloud OCR
  SDK: alibabacloud_ocr_api
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: RecognizeGeneral, RecognizeAdvanced
  Setup hints: ALIBABA_CLOUD_ACCESS_KEY_ID, ALIBABA_CLOUD_ACCESS_KEY_SECRET
  Official docs: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/ocr

Option 4 — Azure Document Intelligence:
  Service: Azure AI Document Intelligence
  SDK: azure-ai-documentintelligence
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: begin_analyze_document
  Setup hints: AZURE_DOCUMENT_INTELLIGENCE_ENDPOINT, AZURE_DOCUMENT_INTELLIGENCE_KEY
  Official docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/ai-services/document-intelligence/overview

Option 5 — Google Document AI:
  Service: Google Document AI
  SDK: google-cloud-documentai
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: process_document
  Setup hints: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
  Official docs: https://cloud.google.com/document-ai/docs/overview

Return exactly one complete implementation. If you use a listed option, adapt its SDK, REST, or protocol surface. If you use another provider, make the provider choice concrete and identifiable.

output_text:
```python
import os
from google.cloud import documentai_v1 as documentai

def extract_layout(document_bytes: bytes) -> None:
    """Extract blocks, lines, and layout elements from a document using Google Document AI."""
    client = documentai.DocumentProcessorServiceClient()
    name = os.environ["GOOGLE_DOCUMENT_AI_PROCESSOR_ID"]
    document = {"content": document_bytes, "mime_type": "application/pdf"}
    input_config = {"document": document}
    response = client.process_document(request={"name": name, "input_config": input_config})
    document = response.document

    for page in document.pages:
        print("Page dimensions:", page.dimension)
        for block in page.blocks:
            print("Block text:", block.text)
            print("Block confidence:", block.confidence)
            print("Block bounds:", block.layout.bounding_box)
            for paragraph in block.paragraphs:
                print("  Paragraph text:", paragraph.text)
                print("  Paragraph confidence:", paragraph.confidence)
                print("  Paragraph bounds:", paragraph.layout.bounding_box)
                for word in paragraph.words:
                    print("    Word text:", word.text)
                    print("    Word confidence:", word.confidence)
                    print("    Word bounds:", word.layout.bounding_box)
                    symbols = [symbol.text for symbol in word.symbols]
                    print("      Symbols:", "".join(symbols))
        for line in page.lines:
            print("Line text:", line.text)
            print("Line confidence:", line.confidence)
            print("Line bounds:", line.layout.bounding_box)
            for token in line.tokens:
                print("  Token text:", token.text)
                print("  Token confidence:", token.confidence)
                print("  Token bounds:", token.layout.bounding_box)
                for symbol in token.symbols:
                    print("    Symbol text:", symbol.text)
                    print("    Symbol confidence:", symbol.confidence)
                    print("    Symbol bounds:", symbol.layout.bounding_box)
```
